notes.title: 🌊 A New Chapter: From Landfall to Shatterland
notes.content:
Hello everyone,


I want to take a moment to speak directly and honestly with you. When I first started developing Landfall, I had a vision in mind—but along the way, the game turned into something different, an extraction-style game. After months of reflection, I realized that this is not the type of experience I truly wanted to build.



That realization was tough, but it pushed me to rethink and restart on a project that aligns much better with my original goals and your expectations as players. That’s why I am now fully focusing on 

Shatterland: 👉 Follow & Wishlist Shatterland on Steam
[hr][/hr]🎁 Rewards for Landfall Players
I know many of you supported Landfall, and I don’t want that to go unrecognized. To thank you:

When Shatterland releases, I’ll post a special redeem code here on this page.
This code will give every Landfall player a reward in Shatterland as a thank-you gift.



Additionally, if you send me a DM on Discord with proof of purchase (a Steam receipt of Landfall), you’ll receive a ːsteamthisːFREE COPY OF SHATTERLAND ːsteamthisː once it’s released.
(Important: the receipt must clearly show the purchase date and information so I can verify it.)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225992/c6aaefe684f250f3ad4c84bf0e45c9d642ba6dab.png"]



Discord:
https://discord.gg/3GY7qqXrM2


[hr][/hr]🙏 A Personal Note
I know Landfall may not have become the game some of you hoped it would be. For me, this whole process has been a learning experience. I want to fix my mistakes by being transparent, by showing you the progress on my new project, and by proving that Shatterland will be a much more complete and enjoyable game.



Thank you for your patience, support, and feedback—it means a lot. I’m excited to share this new adventure with you soon.



Best regards,


 The Shatterland Dev

notes.title: Landfall Dev Update: Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, survivors!

We've been hard at work squashing bugs and adding exciting new content to improve your Landfall experience. Here’s what’s new in the latest update:


 New Bullet Vest Armor: We’ve added two new types of bullet vests, each offering unique levels of protection to suit your survival needs. Experiment with them to find the best fit for your adventures!

 Improved Bullet Vest Functionality: The bullet vests have been enhanced for better durability and performance in the field.

 Campfire Temperature Adjustment: Bullet vests now correctly adjust their temperature when near campfires, keeping you warm and safe during those colder nights.

 Event Weapon Fix: Issues affecting event weapons have been resolved, making each event weapon fully operational and ready to support you in your journey.


Thank you for your support and feedback as we continue to improve Landfall! Stay tuned for more updates and enhancements.

Stay safe, and see you in-game!

notes.title: QOL - Update 2 New Event and Setting!
notes.content:
Hello, Landfall fans! We’re back with an exciting update that brings some long-awaited features and thrilling gameplay improvements to enhance your experience.

New Settings Menu:

We’ve added a comprehensive settings menu, giving you more control over your gameplay experience. You can now adjust the controls to your preference, with options for both inverted and non-inverted settings. Additionally, we’ve added extensive video quality and audio settings, allowing you to fine-tune graphics and sound to perfectly match your setup.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44225992/5615ec996e6c2502adcc19029e29b04345112a50.jpg


New Zombie Spawn System with Mystical Rewards:

Brace yourselves for a new challenge in the Factory map! 
In the normal difficulty level, zombies now have a revamped spawn system that adds a fresh layer of unpredictability and excitement. Surviving the onslaught comes with a new reward: a mystical chest. This rare find will give you access to powerful loot that could make all the difference in your journey.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44225992/6bc64c1cb94e8251f6a3109afa71208a77717892.png

This update is all about delivering more control, immersion, and rewards. 

Dive in, adjust your settings, and face the enhanced challenges we’ve crafted just for you.


 Let us know what you think, and stay tuned for even more updates soon!

notes.title: Dev Update: Collision & Icon Fixes + New Mystical Rewards in the Tutorial!
notes.content:
Hello, Survivors!

I been hard at work polishing Landfall for an even smoother experience. In this update, we’ve addressed a few key areas:

-Collision Fixes: Improved collision detection to make gameplay feel more responsive and natural.

-Icon Adjustments: Resolved some icon issues for better visual clarity.

- Mystical Rewards in Tutorial: Now, you can find an M4 Mystical or SCAR Mystical in the mystical box during the tutorial. Gear up and start strong!


Thanks for your support and feedback!

notes.title: Landfall - Devblog Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello, Landfall adventurers!

I'm back with another update, bringing more improvements to enhance your experience in the demo. Here’s what’s new:

Better Tutorial

We’ve revamped the tutorial to offer clearer instructions and smoother progression, making it easier for new players to jump in and understand the game mechanics.

Quality of Life (QoL) Improvements

Numerous QoL updates have been implemented to improve your gameplay experience, making everything feel more intuitive and player-friendly.

Better Quest Descriptions

Quest descriptions have been refined for better clarity, helping players follow objectives and track progress more easily.

Savegame Issue Fixed

We’ve fixed the issue where removing a savegame required a game reboot. You can now delete save files without restarting.

Zombie Encounters During Special Extractions

Zombies now spawn during certain special extractions, adding a fresh layer of challenge and intensity.
Quest List Fixes

The quest list has been fixed and updated for improved functionality and accuracy.

Purchase List Update

Purchasable items now appear in green instead of red, making it easier to spot what’s available for purchase.

Mystical Crate Added

A Mystical Crate has been added to both hard and no difficulty modes, offering rare rewards to those brave enough to find it.

I hope these changes make Landfall even more enjoyable. Thanks for your continued support and feedback!

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Landfall - New Devblog Update Demo
notes.content:
Landfall Devblog Update

Hello, Landfall adventurers!

We’re excited to share the latest update, packed with new content and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:
New Quests Added

    Fresh quests are now available, offering more challenges and stories for you to explore. Get ready for new missions that will deepen your adventure in Landfall.

Difficulty Unlocks with Quests

    Each unlocked difficulty level now features exclusive quests, adding a layer of challenge and unique rewards as you progress.

New Vendor: The Mod Merchant

    We’ve added a new vendor specializing in weapon mods. Customize your firearms with different mods to improve your gear and tailor your playstyle.

Version Update: Save Screen Adjustment

    We’ve changed how saves are handled. Instead of navigating through a save screen, the game will now return directly to the main menu for a smoother experience.

Audio and Music Enhancements

    Ambient Sounds and Background Music: We’ve introduced ambient music and background sounds to immerse you further into the different levels.
    Level-Specific Music: Each level now features background music that matches the atmosphere, evolving with the game’s environment.

Collision Bug Fixes

    Collision Repairs: We’ve fixed various collision issues, ensuring smoother interactions and preventing players from seeing through objects.

New Crafting Feature: Furnace in the Base

    Players now have access to a furnace in their base for crafting ammunition, providing a more streamlined crafting experience.

These updates aim to make Landfall more immersive and engaging. Thanks for your continued support, and keep the feedback coming!

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Landfall Devblog - New Demo Update
notes.content:
Landfall Devblog Update

Hello, Landfall adventurers!

We’re excited to roll out the latest update, packed with new features, improvements, and content to enhance your journey. Here's what’s new in this patch:
New Quest Content

    Story-Driven Quests: Dive into quests with richer stories, offering more narrative depth and rewarding objectives as you explore the world.
    Factory Map Bunker Quest: Uncover the secrets of a mysterious bunker on the Factory map in this new quest, featuring challenges and lore.

New Difficulty Unlocks

    Factory Difficulty Now Unlocked: The Factory map now includes selectable difficulty levels, allowing players to adjust the challenge to their preference. Tackle tougher enemies and get rewarded with better loot as you push through higher difficulties.

Weapons and Items

    Mystical Weapon at Start: Start your journey with a Mystical weapon, a high-rarity item that adds an extra edge to early-game combat.
    Pistol Instead of AK: The starting weapon has been adjusted to a pistol for a more balanced combat progression.
    Axe Damage Adjusted: Reduced the damage of the axe for better gameplay balance.

World and Gameplay Enhancements

    Vendor Near the Beach: Added a vendor close to the beach for convenient trading options.
    Fishing Dock Added: Try fishing at the new dock for a relaxing and rewarding experience.
    Fiber Plant: New resource added for crafting, expanding the range of materials you can gather.

User Interface and Quality of Life Updates

    Quest UI Update: Added a crafting tab to the quest menu to track crafting objectives more easily.
    Shift + Click Looting: You can now quickly transfer items using Shift + Click for a smoother looting experience.
    Item Rarity Display: Dropped items now show their rarity on the ground for easy identification.

Audio and Animation Fixes

    Music Added to Start Button: New music plays when you start the game, setting the atmosphere right from the beginning.
    Forest Sounds in Tutorial: Enhanced the tutorial environment with ambient forest sounds.
    Shotgun Animation Fix: Improved the shotgun animation for better weapon handling.
    Footstep and Sound Fixes: Balanced sound effects for a more immersive experience.

Balancing Adjustments

    Crafting Balance Changes: Updated crafting recipes for a smoother progression.
    Stealth Grass Fix: Improved the functionality of stealth grass for sneaking gameplay.

These updates aim to make Landfall more engaging and challenging. We’re excited to see how you tackle the new quests and higher difficulties. Keep the feedback coming, and enjoy the adventure!

Happy exploring!

notes.title: Landfall Devblog Demo Update
notes.content:
Landfall Devblog Update

Greetings, Landfall adventurers!

We're back with another exciting update, bringing new features, bug fixes, and gameplay improvements to enhance your experience. Here’s what’s new in Landfall:
New Quest: Build a House

    A new quest has been added, allowing players to build a house on the main land. Gather materials, complete objectives, and establish your own home base. This addition deepens the building mechanics and gives you more rewarding goals to pursue.


Traders and Crafting Enhancements

    New Traders Introduced: We've added traders specializing in construction supplies. Players can now choose to buy or craft items such as the newly refined Storage Chest, which is available for crafting or purchase.
    Quest Text Updates: Improved clarity in quest descriptions by updating terms, such as changing "Chest" to "Storage Chest."
    Trader Inventory Adjustments: We've added more rarity variations to trader items, making it worthwhile to check their stock for high-quality gear.

Gameplay Improvements

    Item Rarity Display: Dropped items now show their rarity on the ground, making it easier to spot valuable loot.
    Shift + Click Looting: We've added a convenient Shift + Click option for quick item transfers, streamlining the looting process.


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44225992/8d736a305021ef8677715ba55c9845b11069d403.jpg

New Content

    Fishing Dock Added: Try your hand at fishing at the new fishing dock! It’s a relaxing break from exploration, offering another way to gather resources.
    Fiber Plant Introduced: The addition of the fiber plant provides a new resource for crafting, expanding gathering options for players.

Shotgun Animation Fix

    Shotgun Animation Improved: We’ve fixed issues with the shotgun animation to ensure smoother and more realistic weapon handling during combat.

Balancing and Fixes

    Crafting Balance: Further adjustments to crafting recipes make material requirements and crafting times more in line with the game’s progression.
    Difficulty Adjustments: We've fine-tuned the difficulty to provide a more balanced challenge.

We hope these changes make Landfall more immersive and enjoyable. Your feedback is invaluable, so be sure to share your thoughts on our community forums.

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Landfall Survival - HUGE DEMO Update!
notes.content:
Survivors, get ready! 


I'm rolled out a brand-new update packed with exciting features, improvements, and fixes to enhance your experience in Landfall Survival Demo. Check out the full details of what’s new and improved below.
New Features
New Quest

A brand-new quest has been added to your survival journey. This quest introduces new challenges, requiring players to manage resources and improve their base. Make sure you're well-prepared because your base management skills will be crucial to succeed!
New Event: Find the Green Orbs

We’ve introduced a dynamic event in the game! As you explore the different biomes in Landfall, you’ll now come across mysterious green orbs. Collect enough of them, and a weapon chest will spawn, filled with rare and powerful gear to give you a survival edge. But be warned: you may not be the only one looking for these treasures…
Enhanced Interaction Feedback

Many players requested clearer interactions with destructible objects. We’ve added visual feedback for breakable doors and harvestable resources like trees and rocks. Now, every interaction will have visual indicators, making it easier for you to understand what can be mined or destroyed.
Friend Addition Feature

We’ve added the ability to invite friends directly in-game! You can now add friends from the in-game menu and play together more easily. This should make teaming up for survival a lot more convenient.
New Loot and Adjustments

The loot system has been expanded! Expect to find new types of loot during your adventures, as well as adjustments to existing loot to balance the game's economy and crafting system. Better loot means better chances of survival—if you can hold on to it!
Fixes and Improvements

    Item Collision Fixes: We’ve resolved issues with item collisions in the game world. Objects will now behave more realistically when interacting with the environment, preventing odd or unintended movements.

    Tutorial Enhancements: Based on player feedback, we’ve added more detailed explanations to the tutorial, making it easier for new players to get up to speed with the game mechanics and survive their early days.

That’s all for this update, but stay tuned for more as we continue to improve and expand Landfall Survival. We’re excited to see how you tackle these new challenges good luck out there!

Maxime
